definitions.explanation: The front part of the body containing the digestive organs.

notes:
{腹|はら} means belly but has many figurative uses.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {腹|はら}が{減|へ}る: to be hungry
- {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ: to get angry
- {腹|はら}を{割|わ}って{話|はな}す: to speak frankly
- {腹|はら}を{決|き}める: to make up one's mind
- {腹黒|はらぐろ}い: scheming, malicious

COMPOUNDS:
- {空腹|くうふく}: hunger
- {満腹|まんぷく}: full stomach
